components.name: Primary Saffron Button
components.description: Primary conversion CTA used for Plan My Trip, Find Trips, and Book/Enquire actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #FF9933; color: #0B1220; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 12px 24px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #F4B942; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #F4B942; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Discover Location Outline Button
components.description: Secondary hero action over full-bleed photography.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { background: rgba(11, 18, 32, 0.55); color: #F5F5F5; border: 1.5px solid rgba(245, 245, 245, 0.9); border-radius: 9999px; padding: 12px 24px; font-size: 15px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1), color 0.2s, border-color 0.2s; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: #FF9933; border-color: #FF9933; color: #0B1220; }

components.name: Sharp Hero Destination Card
components.description: Borderless, zero-radius rectangular hero card that expands behind sibling cards on selection.
components.css: .ds-hero-card { position: relative; width: 196px; height: 280px; border-radius: 0; background: linear-gradient(to top, rgba(11,18,32,0.92), rgba(24,42,68,0.55)); box-shadow: 0 24px 48px rgba(7,12,22,0.55); overflow: hidden; } .ds-hero-card-meta { position: absolute; bottom: 14px; left: 16px; color: #F7F3EC; } .ds-hero-dash { display: block; width: 16px; height: 2px; background: rgba(247,243,236,0.85); margin-bottom: 6px; } .ds-hero-region { display: block; font-size: 11px; opacity: 0.8; } .ds-hero-name { display: block; font-size: 19px; font-weight: 700; }

narrative.overview: Priti Travels Hub alternates deep twilight cinema chapters with sun-warmed editorial ivory spreads. Every region is introduced as a full-bleed moving frame rather than a cramped package brochure.
keyCharacteristics: Deep midnight navy (#0B1220) nocturnal atmosphere paired with warm off-white (#F7F3EC) editorial chapters.
Condensed uppercase display headlines (Bebas Neue) paired with Playfair Display italic accents and clean Inter body text.
Subtle 70mm film grain, directional legibility scrims, and GPU-composited clip-path reveals.

rules.name: The Alternating Rhythm Rule
rules.body: Dark midnight navy chapters and warm ivory editorial chapters alternate across the scroll to give photography breathing room and prevent visual fatigue.

dos: Do keep hero destination cards borderless, sharp (0px), and equal-sized, advancing the carousel only after the behind-card clip-path reveal completes.
Do preserve prefers-reduced-motion fallbacks and the static SVG India map fallback for non-WebGL contexts.
donts: Don't add vertical decorative stripes, eyebrow kickers above headings, or borders onto hero destination cards.
Don't hardcode destination copy or image URLs inside components; store all editable data in src/data/travelData.ts.
